sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def glyph(fr,r0,c0):
    return tuple(''.join('#' if fr[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def s(g): return ''.join(''.join(r) for r in g)
def wpos():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    return [(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in seg if n['color']=='W']
print('before: P0=',s(glyph(a,52,13)),' W=',wpos())
action(['RIGHT'], intent='explore')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('after RIGHT: W=',wpos(),' P1=',s(glyph(a,52,20)))
action(['UP'], intent='explore')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('after UP:    W=',wpos(),' P1=',s(glyph(a,52,20)),' P0=',s(glyph(a,52,13)))
# restore: DOWN once to undo the UP on P1
action(['DOWN'], intent='explore')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('after DOWN:  W=',wpos(),' P1=',s(glyph(a,52,20)))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<function=python>
<parameter=code>

a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def glyph(fr,r0,c0):
    return tuple(''.join('#' if fr[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def s(g): return ''.join(''.join(r) for r in g)
def wpos():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    return [(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in seg if n['color']=='W']
print('before: P0=',s(glyph(a,52,13)),' W=',wpos())
action(['RIGHT'], intent='explore')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('after RIGHT: W=',wpos(),' P1=',s(glyph(a,52,20)))
action(['UP'], intent='explore')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('after UP:    W=',wpos(),' P1=',s(glyph(a,52,20)),' P0=',s(glyph(a,52,13)))
# restore: DOWN once to undo the UP on P1
action(['DOWN'], intent='explore')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('after DOWN:  W=',wpos(),' P1=',s(glyph(a,52,20)))
</parameter>
</function>
